One field, step, decides what's shown. Getters isStep1, isStep2, isStep3 feed lwc:if, since templates can't compare.
Bind each input's value to a field (value={name}) and update the field on input. When a step's markup is re-created after Back, value={name} restores what was typed.

Validate in the Next handler: compute an error string for the current step; if it's non-empty, set this.error and return without changing step. An email check that's good enough here: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email.trim()).
